items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Herbie Haymer was the only one she used out of her band. She used Roy's band and Herbie Haymer.

ctx.x: I'll do that. But any way at this time when I was with Art, and Scoops Carrier was in the band, and Scoops as I told you was a tremendous saxophonist. Everybody came in. And Mildred Bailey and Red Norva used to come in every night. They were working at the Black hawk. So Art left and then we stayed on with Roy Eldridge, and she just loved Little Jazz. We called her Bailes. She'd come in every night. But I don't know, I'm thinking now. We recorded -- we did some beautiful things with her. We recorded with Mildred…

Herbie Haymer was the only one she used out of her band. She used Roy's band and Herbie Haymer. Now, I think at this time Dave Barber was playing guitar with her, in her band. Bill Miller was playing piano, you know, with -- he's
with Sinatra, he's his conductor now. All these people know that I exist.
